reason: The README clearly identifies this as a DSH plugin for persistent cross-session agent memory with save, search, health, service, and dashboard capabilities, but it also states that the repository has been merged into @bryan-cmf/dsh-insights and is retained only as historical source.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供跨会话持久化记忆的保存、搜索、健康检查服务，并在界面中展示记忆条目。
summaries.en: Provides agents with cross-session persistent memory through save, search, and health tools, plus a dashboard view for stored memory items.

capabilities: reports memory storage health and TTL status
publishes a vectorMemory service for other plugins
provides a memory dashboard view tab
